title: Not too thick and provides enough cushioning to make the tatami comfortable.
text:
Not too thick and provides enough cushioning to make the tatami comfortable.. I write this review with the caveat that I normally prefer firm mattresses that do not have a pillowtop.

In my house, I have a very small room that was sitting unused because with a guest bed inside, the room was only useable as a guest bedroom. To make it more useful, I had the idea that I would convert the room to a Tatami room. Suddenly, the room was useable as a reading/tv room. With the entire floorspace available as a sitting area, we can even fit many more people into it than previously.

To ensure that we can still use it as a guest bedroom, it was necessary to buy mattresses that can be easily stowed away in the closet.

The NAGI Japanese Futon Mattress fit the bill nicely. It's not as costly as many others available here and it has enough cushioning to make the tatami comfortable to sleep on. I haven't had a complaint from my guests yet regarding it being too thin.

Just note, though. The sizing on this is not standard to American mattress sizes. The twin size matches well enough but the full-size that I received was only a couple of inches wider than the twin. Please check the dimensions before purchasing.

features: A GOOD SLEEP WITH JAPANESE STYLE: Futon mattress is traditional Japanese bedding. You can relax on it because it supports your back and lower back with a comfortable firmness. After a while lying down, you will fall into a good, deep sleep.

MADE IN JAPAN: This product is a high-quality Futon mattress made by the Japanese Futon manufacturer that has a history of over 150 years. The skilled craftsmen complete one by one carefully and delicately.

DURABLE AND COMFORTABLE: Diamond quilting is adopted as the sewing method. Compared to ordinary quilting, diamond quilting sews together a wider area. Therefore, the padding is less likely to be unevenly distributed, and the durability of the Japanese Futon mattress increases.

COMPACT AND SAVE SPACE: It is easy to fold and put away the Japanese Futon mattress, so you can free up space in your room. Light and easy to carry, it can be used in an apartment, living alone, in a children's room, or taken out to camp.
EASY TO CARE: Unlike the large bed mattress, the Japanese Futon mattress can be dried in the sun on sunny days. This will keep your Futon clean at all times.
